title: PII Types — NORA
description: Canonical PII types detected/redacted by the PII Shield (ADR 0012). Every client that renders redactions MUST know this enum. Source of truth: services/nlp-worker/src/nora_nlp/models.py:PiiType.

x-implementations.java: services/api/src/main/java/br/com/nora/api/domain/... (unused today; the backend does not persist the PII type directly)

x-notes.ADDRESS: Emitted since 2026-08-17 (ADR 0042). A deterministic recogniser over Brazilian street-type openers (Rua, Avenida, Alameda, Rodovia, Estrada, Praca, Largo, Travessa) followed by a capitalised street name, an optional number and an optional complement; it claims the whole stretch. It is NOT NER: an address whose name is lower-cased or purely numeric is out of scope, and the street type word alone is never enough. Not mirrored in the BFF's `apps/web/src/lib/pii/redact.ts`, which carries only the structured patterns with near-zero false positives — see the header of that file.
x-notes.OTHER: Catch-all for future extensions; the client should render it as a generic type.
